title: Song Title
chord_tones_instructions: Custom chords can be added in the form 'chord_name': ['note1', 'note2', ...]
verse_instructions: Each array of lines corresponds to one line of lyrics
Each lyric object's type may be any string and must exactly match a top-level note pattern name
Each named pattern must have as many line arrays as its lyric block has lines
Add the 'breath_after' boolean to any line to indicate a full pause
Add 'exclude_notes': ['A4', 'C5'] to a note to omit those available bells, including melody; sounding excluded bells are damped
